extension.summary: Swiss army knife for Kodi developers and power users
extension.description: Dev Toolbox is a modular Kodi development suite featuring an in-GUI code/text editor, live debug toggles (Kodi log, skin debug, reload skin), an addon inspector, a log viewer with QR code upload, and a dedicated custom WindowXML keymap editor.
extension.news:
[B]1.1.0[/B] - Add Official Kodi Addon & Dependency Installer - Add rich editor-styled WindowXML Log Viewer with appearance style toggle - Switch QR code generation to script.module.qrcode - Integrate script.module.urldispatcher and refactor router.py to lightweight entry point - Full British English localization of all custom WindowXML dialogs - Add Quit Kodi entry to main menu - Remove redundant error-only log viewer entry
[B]1.0.0[/B] - Initial release featuring In-GUI Code Editor with syntax styling and test execution - Safe WindowXML Addon Inspector with crash-proof details viewer - Visual multi-scope WindowXML Keymap Editor - Kodi Log Viewer with paste upload & mobile QR code pairing - Real-time debug toggles for logging, skin overlay, and instant skin reload - Dynamic theme engine with texture cache path isolation
